error.mode_not_available_v0_4: This source mode is not implemented in V0.9. Select one signed live grid-power sensor.
error.invalid_contracted_power_periods: Contracted-power assignments are invalid, overlapping, or have an end date before the start date.

user.title: Meter source
user.description: V0.9 fully supports a signed W or kW grid-power sensor. Other source designs remain visibly unavailable.

data_description.source_mode: Choose the input type. In V0.9 only a single signed power sensor (W or kW) is operational; other modes cannot yet be configured.

meter.title: Source polarity
meter.description: Choose the W or kW sensor and how its sign works. Internally, positive always means import and negative always means export. You can change this later.

data_description.power_entity: Select the grid-connection power sensor (W or kW), not total house consumption or PV production. Current readings will be normalized into import (+) and export (−).
data_description.positive_means_import: Enable if a positive raw sensor reading means electricity imported from the grid. Disable if positive means grid export, as with some SolarEdge sensors. Review the live polarity preview.

polarity_preview.title: Check normalized direction
polarity_preview.description: {preview} If the direction is wrong, go back and reverse the polarity choice.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

contract.title: Contracted-power validity
contract.description: Dates are inclusive local dates. The optional record date and provenance preserve the distributor assignment's audit trail.

data_description.assignment_start_date: First local calendar date on which this contracted-power assignment applies (inclusive). For example, 2026-01-01.
data_description.assignment_end_date: Last local calendar date for these limits (inclusive). The system does not silently extend the assignment into future years.
data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date printed or recorded on the distributor's assignment. This is evidence/provenance, not the start of validity.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Identify who provided these limits, for example 'distributor assignment'. Kept with archived contract metadata.

target_mode.title: Contracted-power mode
target_mode.description: A contracted limit is a 15-minute average import-demand target, not instantaneous breaker or phase capacity.

data_description.target_mode: Use one shared kW limit for B1–B5, or enter five independent limits. These are limits for 15-minute import demand, not electrical breaker capacity.

shared_target.title: Shared B1-B5 target
shared_target.description: This value will be saved for all five tariff blocks in the dated assignment.

data_description.target_kw: Agreed 15-minute average IMPORT power in kW. Shared mode copies this exact limit into all five tariff blocks for the selected dates.

individual_targets.title: Individual B1-B5 targets
individual_targets.description: Enter the distributor-assigned 15-minute contracted power for every block.

data_description.target_b1_kw: Distributor-assigned B1 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B1 applies.
data_description.target_b2_kw: Distributor-assigned B2 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B2 applies.
data_description.target_b3_kw: Distributor-assigned B3 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B3 applies.
data_description.target_b4_kw: Distributor-assigned B4 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B4 applies.
data_description.target_b5_kw: Distributor-assigned B5 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B5 applies.

calculation.title: Calculation settings
calculation.description: Defaults may be submitted unchanged. Provisional 2028-2030 tariff continuation is disabled unless explicitly enabled.

data.allow_provisional_tariff: Allow provisional tariffs for unverified years

data_description.safety_margin_kw: Optional planning buffer (kW) subtracted from the agreed limit when calculating operational headroom. Default 0.00 kW; does not change the contract.
data_description.smoothing_seconds: Averages recent signed power for the end-of-quarter forecast. 30 s reacts faster; 120 s is steadier but slower to follow changes.
data_description.sustained_horizon_minutes: How long (15/30/60/120 min) continuous extra demand is evaluated, including any stricter tariff blocks coming next.
data_description.retention: How long completed 15-minute quarters remain in the integration-owned SQLite database. 'Forever' preserves them across normal HA recorder purges.
data_description.allow_provisional_tariff: Opt in to explicitly provisional continuation of the 2027 block pattern for unverified years 2028–2030. Without opt-in no future block/limit is claimed as confirmed.
data_description.simulation_enabled: Use a temporary comparison threshold without changing the distributor-assigned B1–B5 schedule. Simulated results never count as confirmed contractual statistics.
data_description.simulation_target_kw: Temporary kW threshold used only while simulation is enabled. It does not overwrite dated contracted-power assignments or archived provenance.

review.title: Review and install

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

settings.title: Calculation and meter settings
settings.description: Changing source or polarity creates a new configuration epoch. Unavailable or stale advice is never converted to zero.
